pr_body:
# Split KestrelTrace into multiple files

Split KestrelTrace up into multiple files for better organization.

## Description

Refactored KestrelTrace into 5 new files:
- KestrelTrace.BadRequests
- KestrelTrace.Connections
- KestrelTrace.General
- KestrelTrace.Http2
- KestrelTrace.Http3

Current IDs were kept for backwards compatibility, but new logs can be added starting at 60 for each category.

Fixes #41143

Perfect. This is much more organized and understandable. Thanks!

issue_context.title: Order KestrelTrace by event ID
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Describe the bug

During a refactor some Kestrel trace log methods were reordered to group them together by logic. This makes it difficult to understand what event IDs (an incrementing number) are used, and what the next event ID should be.
 https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/c00e0e775208cb7cb377f9bd0c8a66a0b3d0ed4d/src/Servers/Kestrel/Core/src/Internal/Infrastructure/KestrelTrace.cs

### Expected Behavior

Methods ordered by event ID, e.g. 0, 1, 2, 3, etc. That means oldest to newest.
